findings.statement: The North region has the highest total sales amount among all regions in the dataset.
findings.method: SQL aggregation (SUM) grouped by region, ordered by total_sales DESC
findings.code: SELECT region, SUM(amount) as total_sales FROM sales_by_region WHERE region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_sales DESC

data_quality_notes: Duplicate rows: 5 duplicate rows found in the dataset
Null values in region column: 12 nulls (3.0%) - these were filtered out in analysis
No nulls in order_id or amount columns
assumptions: Analysis only includes rows with non-null region values
Total sales amounts are summed as-is without currency conversion
limitations: Duplicate rows may affect accuracy of totals if not deduplicated first
Small sample sizes in some regions could impact reliability (west has 96 rows, north has 119 rows)
No outlier analysis was performed on amount values
